cssVariables.note: Tokens live as custom properties on :root in src/app.html. Frontmatter key -> CSS variable.

themes.dark: Applied by @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) on :root:not([data-theme="light"]) and by :root[data-theme="dark"]; per-token values in colorMeta.<token>.dark. The hover filter becomes brightness(1.25) and color-scheme is dark.

ai-indigo.purpose: Controls, pressed states, focus, progress, links.

ai-soft.purpose: Tint behind pressed segments, active region chips, checked quiz type.

shu-vermilion.purpose: The single selected prefecture, quiz target, active tab underline, code seal, hanko.

sea.purpose: Map frame and Okinawa inset background.

quiz-land.purpose: Neutral land on the Quiz map.

border-edge.purpose: Prefecture borders on neutral land, inset frame, control hover borders, type-in stroke.

region-separator.purpose: Prefecture borders on the coloured Explore map.

sumi-ink.purpose: Text, leader line, target ring, scale bar, tooltip ground.

rule.purpose: Every hairline border and divider; progress track.

ok.purpose: Correct feedback text and borders, population increase.

bad.purpose: Wrong feedback, armed confirm, hatch lines, population decrease.

bad-fill.purpose: Missed prefectures (under hatch), wrong answer cards, missed-name chip borders.

region-chugoku.purpose: Region fill and swatch; age bar elderly segment.

region-shikoku.purpose: Region fill and swatch; age bar youth segment.

region-kyushu.purpose: Region fill and swatch (Kyūshū and Okinawa).

display.purpose: Prefecture or region kanji: 48px callout, 46px drawer, 40px quiz prompt, 34px on phones.

score.purpose: Quiz result number; denominator at 22px muted.

wordmark.purpose: 都道府県 in the top bar.

headline.purpose: Drawer and quiz panel headings; section headings inside tabs use the body face at 15px/700.

title.purpose: Romaji name under the kanji (21px in the drawer), kana beside it at 13–14px muted.

figure.purpose: Fact values with tabular numerals (18px in the drawer), muted rank line beneath.

control.purpose: Tool toggles, region chips, selects, small buttons.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked term labels directly above a value or field; never above a heading.

shadows.name: callout-float
shadows.purpose: Callout card floating over the map; removed when docked on phones.

shadows.name: swatch-keyline
shadows.purpose: Keeps pale region swatches visible on paper.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Responses: press, enter, drawer, progress, hanko stamp.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Things travelling across the screen: the mode thumb.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every pressable control gives way; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: colour-change
motion.purpose: Border, background, fill and opacity changes.

motion.name: mode-thumb
motion.purpose: Indigo thumb sliding between Explore and Quiz.

motion.name: drawer
motion.purpose: Reading drawer and phone bottom sheet.

motion.name: map-view
motion.purpose: Map pan and zoom to a selection or region; instant under reduced motion.

motion.name: hanko-stamp
motion.purpose: Perfect-score seal pressed onto the page.

motion.name: wrong-flash
motion.purpose: Wrong tap on the Find it map.

motion.name: label-pop
motion.purpose: Newly named label in Name them all.

breakpoints.name: phone-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Tighter panel padding, wordmark subtitle hidden, smaller figures.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Single column; callout docks under the map; drawer becomes a bottom sheet; map max 52vh.

breakpoints.name: coarse-pointer
breakpoints.purpose: 44px minimum touch targets on map tools, chips and callout buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One per group: Read more, Start, Check, Play again.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d2dae0); background: var(--surface, #fbfcfc); color: var(--ink, #1b2230); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; font: 500 15px/1.6 "Zen Kaku Gothic New", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ai, #284a8b); color: var(--ai-ink, #ffffff); border-color: var(--ai, #284a8b); font-weight: 700; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--edge, #75828e); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--ai, #284a8b); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ai, #284a8b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary and Ghost Buttons
components.description: Paper-faced secondary; borderless muted ghost for Close and I don't know.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d2dae0); background: var(--surface, #fbfcfc); color: var(--ink, #1b2230); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; font: 500 15px/1.6 "Zen Kaku Gothic New", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn2-ghost { border-color: transparent; background: none; color: var(--muted, #5a6474); } .ds-btn2:hover { border-color: var(--edge, #75828e); } .ds-btn2-ghost:hover { border-color: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1b2230); } .ds-btn2:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ai, #284a8b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mode Toggle
components.description: Explore / Quiz pill with one indigo thumb.
components.css: .ds-modes { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; background: var(--surface, #fbfcfc); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d2dae0); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; font: 500 15px/1.6 "Zen Kaku Gothic New", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-modes button { border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink, #1b2230); padding: 6px 18px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; transition: color 200ms ease, background-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-modes button.ds-on { background: var(--ai, #284a8b); color: var(--ai-ink, #ffffff); } .ds-modes button:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-modes button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ai, #284a8b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tool Group
components.description: Segmented map tool with drawn 16px stroke icons; pressed segment is indigo on ai-soft.
components.css: .ds-tools { display: inline-flex; background: var(--surface, #fbfcfc); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d2dae0); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; font: 500 13px/1.4 "Zen Kaku Gothic New", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tools button { border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink, #1b2230); padding: 5px 10px; min-width: 34px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-tools button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, #d2dae0); } .ds-tools button.ds-on { background: var(--ai-soft, #e3e9f4); color: var(--ai, #284a8b); font-weight: 700; } .ds-tools button:hover:not(.ds-on) { background: var(--bg, #e8edf0); } .ds-tools button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ai, #284a8b); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Region Chip
components.description: Pill with a region swatch; pressing one zooms the map to that region.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d2dae0); background: var(--surface, #fbfcfc); color: var(--ink, #1b2230); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 10px 3px 7px; font: 500 12px/1.4 "Zen Kaku Gothic New", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-chip.ds-on { border-color: var(--ai, #284a8b); background: var(--ai-soft, #e3e9f4); color: var(--ai, #284a8b); font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip:hover:not(.ds-on) { border-color: var(--edge, #75828e); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ai, #284a8b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sw { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / .12); }

components.name: Type-in Field
components.description: Answer field in Name it; focus turns the stroke indigo.
components.css: .ds-typein { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 8px; } .ds-typein input { padding: 10px 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--edge, #75828e); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #fbfcfc); color: var(--ink, #1b2230); font: 400 17px/1.4 "Zen Kaku Gothic New", system-ui, sans-serif; min-width: 0; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-typein input:focus { border-color: var(--ai, #284a8b); outline: none; } .ds-typein button { border: 1px solid var(--ai, #284a8b); background: var(--ai, #284a8b); color: var(--ai-ink, #ffffff); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font: 700 15px/1.6 "Zen Kaku Gothic New", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-typein button:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-typein button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ai, #284a8b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Seal and Hanko
components.description: Vermilion seals: the rotated prefecture-code seal in the drawer and the stamped 全問正解 hanko on a perfect score.
components.css: .ds-seal { border: 2px solid var(--shu, #cc4a2c); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--shu, #cc4a2c) 85%, var(--ink, #1b2230)); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 7px 4px; text-align: center; font: 700 15px/1.1 "Zen Kaku Gothic New", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-seal small { display: block; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-seal span { font: 800 20px/1.1 "Shippori Mincho B1", "Yu Mincho", serif; } .ds-hanko { width: 76px; height: 76px; border: 3px solid var(--shu, #cc4a2c); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--shu, #cc4a2c); display: grid; place-items: center; text-align: center; font: 800 19px/1.05 "Shippori Mincho B1", "Yu Mincho", serif; transform: rotate(-8deg); animation: ds-stamp 320ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) 150ms backwards; } @keyframes ds-stamp { from { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-8deg) scale(1.35); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hanko { animation: none; } }

narrative.northStar: The Survey Sheet and Its Seal
narrative.overview:
The page is a survey sheet of Japan laid on cool washi-grey paper. The map is not an illustration beside the content; it is the stage, framed edge to edge in a pale sea with a fine graticule, and everything else either sits on a thin paper strip above it (tools, regions) or speaks from inside it (the callout card, tied to its prefecture by an ink leader line). Reading in depth happens one step away, in a drawer that slides over the map's right edge rather than claiming a permanent column.

Colour is quiet and assigned by meaning. Indigo 藍 is the hand of the interface: controls, pressed states, focus, progress. Vermilion 朱 is the seal: it marks the one chosen place, the active reading tab, the prefecture code seal and the perfect-score hanko, and nothing else. Region pastels carry geography on the Explore map; on the Quiz map the land goes neutral so the learner's own marks (found, late, missed) carry the colour. Japanese is set as content, in a heavy Mincho, at the largest size on the screen.

The density is a field atlas's: compact controls, tabular figures, small tracked labels over large bold numbers, hairline rules between groups. Depth comes from paper on paper with thin borders; only floating things (the callout and the drawer) cast a soft ambient shadow.
keyCharacteristics: The map owns the viewport; content floats over it or docks beneath it on phones.
Two inks only: indigo for controls, vermilion for selection and seals.
Kanji in Shippori Mincho B1 is the biggest type on any screen; UI is Zen Kaku Gothic New.
Hairline borders and tonal paper, not shadows, separate surfaces.
Light and dark themes are full token sets, switched by `prefers-color-scheme` or `data-theme`.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Indigo points at what you can do; vermilion marks what is chosen or sealed. Never use vermilion for a control or indigo for a selection.

rules.name: The One Red Place Rule
rules.body: On any map state, at most one prefecture is filled vermilion. Region views highlight with fades, not more red.

rules.name: The Learner's Colour Rule
rules.body: On the Quiz map the land is neutral; only the learner's results (found, late, missed) and the single target carry colour.

rules.name: The Kanji Is Largest Rule
rules.body: On any screen the largest text is Japanese in Mincho (or the score). English never outranks the kanji it translates.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that can be compared (population, area, ranks, timers, scores, scale) uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Only Floating Things Cast Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a shadow only if it hovers over the map. Strips, chips, panels and buttons stay flat.

dos: **Do** let the map take the full width in Explore and bring content to it (callout, drawer) instead of giving content a permanent column.
**Do** keep indigo for controls and vermilion for the single selection, the active tab underline and the seals (The Two Inks Rule).
**Do** set every prefecture and region name in kanji, kana and romaji together, with the kanji in Shippori Mincho B1 as the largest text.
**Do** separate surfaces with a 1px `rule` hairline and a tonal step; reserve shadow for cards floating over the map.
**Do** use tabular numerals and an "#n of 47" rank for every comparable figure.
**Do** mark quiz misses with the hatch as well as the colour, so state never depends on hue alone.
**Do** draw icons as 16px stroke SVGs (1.75 stroke, round caps) and give touch targets 44px under coarse pointers.
**Do** define every new colour in both light and dark token sets.
donts: **Don't** split Explore into a map on the left and a card column on the right; the reading panel is a drawer.
**Don't** fill more than one prefecture vermilion, or use vermilion on a button.
**Don't** colour quiz land by region; the learner's results are the only colour there.
**Don't** put small uppercase labels above headings; tracked uppercase is only for labels that name the value directly beneath them.
**Don't** set UI copy or English body text in the Mincho.
**Don't** add hover effects that fire on touch; hover rules live behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
